title.narrative: Provision of integrated life-saving Health assistance to the most vulnerable communities in under-served and hard-to-reach rural areas in Qasaxdhere district of Bay region.

description.narrative: ltpgtAs of early 2025, humanitarian situation in Somalia remained deeply concerning, characterized by sustained malnutrition, disease outbreaks, and fragile healthcare access. Approximately 3.4 million people were already experiencing IPC Phase 3 and worse by the beginning of January 2025. Bay Region is classified in IPC Phase 3–4 through mid-2025, signaling crisis to emergency food insecurity levels. ( fsnau.org). Ongoing La Niña–linked droughts and persistent funding gaps have kept malnutrition at “Serious to Critical” levels in Bay Region. ltspangtThe project was designed to address the critical health needs identified in the Rapid Needs Assessment conducted in Qansax Dheere bylt/spangtlt/pgtltpgtOCHA and partners from 2–3 March 2025. The assessment revealed that only 3% of the population had access to functional health services, while a staggering 71% of women in labor were unable to reach a health facility. As a result, many mothers tragically die on the road while attempting to access care, highlighting severe gaps in maternal and RH services. The situation is further exacerbated by widespread disease outbreaks, with acute watery diarrhea (97%), malaria (58%), and respiratory infections (35%) reported as leading causes of illness and death. The facilities will include: Qasaxdhere health Centre and Mobile sites in the IDPs of Tiirka, Mubarak, Loforar, Buulo Abag, Xafito and Manyow. Additionally, the assessment identified PLW, the elderly and individuals with disabilities as the most vulnerable groups in urgent need of targeted health interventions. The limited availability of antenatal, delivery, and postnatal services, alongside the lack of structured pathways to identify and refer vulnerable individuals, revealed a pressing need to reorganize patient flow systems and scale up integrated outreach efforts. The proposed project will support 1 static health facility and 2 mobile centers in the Qasaxdhere district. CRPD plans to deliver an integrated package of promotive, preventive, and curative maternal, newborn child health services and scale-up outbreak early warning and response and case management of epidemic-prone diseases through the mobile response team as part of the efforts to support the drought-affected communities in Qasaxdhere. The project aims to scale up the static and mobile clinics in Qasaxdhere IDP and host community and scale up the health care through skilled health professionals. CRPD through this project will provide regular medical supplies and life-saving drugs to established health facilities and improve the coverage of measles vaccinations, and support safe motherhood and reproductive health while also ensuring readiness to prevent and respond to outbreaks such as malaria, measles or AWD/Cholera and promote health update through health education and beneficiary sensitization including management of rape and GBV. The project will engages the PLWD, minority groups and women and girls by ensuring representation, allow access, direct engagement, collaborate, train and engage them as staff and beneficiariesltbrgtThe activities to be undertaken will include:ltbrgtProvide Outpatient consultations to drought-affected IDPs in Qasaxdhere districtltbrgtProvide routine and campaign immunization to under 5 children and TT to WBCAltbrgtEnsure the treatment of common diseases such as pneumonia, diarrhea/dehydration, malaria, and skin conditionsltbrgtProvide antenatal and post-natal care to pregnant and lactating mothers at the 1 static health facility and the 2 Mobile sites.ltbrgtMaintain and continue the services being provided at the 1 static health facility and the 2 mobile sitesltbrgtConduct a community mobilization and awareness-raising workshop at the start of the project for 100 peopleltbrgtProcure Medical supplies and ensure that the 1 static and 2 mobiles facilities have enough supplies throughout the project period.ltbrgtProvision of quality multi-sectoral services.
